title: 基于音素专家混合的Conformer低秩适配用于带口音英语语音识别
summary: 提出MoPE-LoRA，按发音方式类别组织六个低秩专家，通过音素监督与声学门控的混合路由实现帧级分配。专家集跨口音共享，无需口音专属模块，可泛化到未见口音。在L2-ARCTIC上优于单LoRA和全量微调，零样本口音留出时相对提升12.3%。
summary_en: We present MoPE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for accented English speech recognition that organizes six low-rank experts by manner-of-articulation classes with hybrid frame-level routing combining phoneme supervision and acoustic gating. Experts are shared across accents, requiring no accent-specific modules and generalizing to unseen accents. On L2-ARCTIC it consistently beats single LoRA and full fine-tuning, yielding a 12.3% relative gain over single LoRA in zero-shot held-out accent evaluation.
